dependency_plan.name: Concrete symmetric-ideal C model
obligations: Instantiate FunCat for E and O with the four specified arrow classes; prove identity and composition closure.
Instantiate the root and old/new-preserving symmetry groups, inverses, and the finite pinning ideal.
Prove finite injection prescription and finite permutation extension lemmas for the relevant source-target cases.
Apply SymBase.model_isModel; no new model-soundness axiom is needed.

dependency_plan.name: Uniform all-type pair classification
obligations: For arbitrary rho : RTy, use Args model.inner rho at E and O without adding fullness of the recursive argument domains.
An admitted root entity pinned by finite S is determined by its profiles at identity_E and old inclusion.
Extend each root outgoing arrow restricted to S to an appropriate target symmetry.
Use symmetry and pinning to recover every profile; inverse symmetries act bijectively on arbitrary higher-type argument tuples.

dependency_plan.name: Converse admission and order
obligations: Given two component subsets invariant under Fix_E(S) and Fix_O(iS), reconstruct an intension.
An existential definition over all extending symmetries avoids selecting a particular extension.
Stabilizer invariance makes the definition independent of the extension; symmetry follows by target composition.
Local profile pinning upgrades to equality of transported intensions because further postcomposition preserves agreement on S.
Apply SymBase.mem_range_iff.
Show algebraic order is componentwise subset inclusion using one common finite support.

dependency_plan.name: Full represented Boolean completeness
obligations: The actual extension of any admitted family is invariant under root symmetries fixing its finite support.
Take componentwise intersections of that actual family to obtain official GLBs directly; the note's componentwise unions equally supply LUBs.
Invariance under old-coordinate permutations follows from root-family invariance; invariance under new-coordinate permutations follows separately for every component.
Reconstruct and admit the meet pair, then use the pair-order equivalence.
Finish with Premodel.holds_bc_iff. P.BooleanCompleteness.quoted rho = Sentence.bc rho is definitionally true.
Empty families and rho = t are included.

dependency_plan.name: Full ND
obligations: Every root outgoing arrow f is finitely invertible: for each root h and finite S, an allowed k satisfies k composed with f agrees with h on S.
Two distinct root relations remain distinct after f, using a common support and a separating tuple at h.
Individual transport is injective by definition of every arrow.
Finish with Premodel.holds_nd_iff at every admitted type.

dependency_plan.name: IC_et and RC_et failure
obligations: A candidate Y coextensive with universal individuals has universal profiles at all arrows into E, by finite extension, symmetry and pinning.
Admit the empty-pinned old predicate U: all individuals at E-targets, precisely old individuals at O-targets.
Every current root individual necessarily satisfies U; inextensibility at E implies Y is below U, so Y at the old inclusion contains only old individuals.
Fix a new b at O. All current Y-members are necessarily unequal to b because every arrow on individuals is injective.
Inextensibility at the inclusion implies the transported Y is below the admitted predicate lambda x, x unequal b.
Any return arrow O to E yields the contradiction at the image of b, since the root-to-E profile is universal.
RC_et failure follows from its inextensibility conjunct or the certified RC to IC implication.

dependency_plan.name: Exact non-entailments
obligations: Assemble model.HoldsAx for the full unboxed ND and BC schemas.
Apply Premodel.not_theorem_of_model with the failed et instance.
Derive non-entailment of the IC and RC schemas without replacing the target by an informal proxy.

reusable_lean_api.note: Its equality is rfl; importing the whole model module is unnecessary merely to obtain it.
Alternatively refute RC directly from its semantic inextensibility conjunct.

pitfalls.issue: Pointwise unions of current intensions need not be admitted
pitfalls.explanation: For the family of all root individual haecceities, the pointwise union at h:E to E is range(h). This may fail finite pinning. The correct join reconstructed from the component pair has profile all E at every E-target.
pitfalls.remedy: Reconstruct from componentwise pair unions or intersections; do not assert that the raw union of all intensions is the join.

pitfalls.issue: SymBase.HullConditions is not an available shortcut
pitfalls.explanation: Its arbitrary finite arrow-splicing requirement can fail for injections because prescribed image values collide outside the shared finite support.
pitfalls.remedy: Use an independent pair proof and Premodel.holds_bc_iff, or SymBase.HasLUBs followed by holds_bc_lub_at.

pitfalls.issue: External even-haecceity family is not admitted
pitfalls.explanation: That family is not invariant under all root permutations fixing any finite set.
pitfalls.remedy: Do not formalize it as an object-domain family or use the original BC-failure verdict.

pitfalls.explanation: Full BC holds at E, but the corrected future old-haecceity family shows BC_et fails at O; root ND also need not persist.
pitfalls.remedy: Keep ND and BC unboxed in the final premise schema.
